channel.title: Refrigerated & Frozen Foods - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Refrigerated & Frozen Foods (refrigeratedfrozenfood.com)

item.title: IPPE ’26 Sets Show Floor Record
item.description: With over 660,000 square feet of exhibit space and 1,300+ exhibitors, it marked the largest show floor in IPPE’s history.

item.title: REMIX from Oikos & Light + Fit Launches Craveable Flavors
item.description: With 11 grams of complete protein in every 4.5-ounce cup (making it an excellent source of protein), you can rest easy knowing you’re snacking strong with every spoonful.

item.title: Bel Group Appoints McGuinness as CEO of Bel North America
item.description: A proven category leader and disruptor, McGuinness steps into the role at a pivotal moment for Bel as the company accelerates its growth in the market and advances its purposeful snacking strategy.

item.title: Cedar’s Foods Turns Up the Heat with LTO Organic Pineapple Jalapeño Hommus
item.description: Available as a limited-time batch, this bold new flavor blends organic steamed chickpeas with juicy pineapple and a kick of jalapeño for a tropical twist that’s uniquely unexpected, craveable and seriously snackable.

item.title: Corvus Robotics Debuts Cold Chain Drones for Autonomous Inventory
item.description: Kroger is using the system in freezer operations for consistent inventory visibility and to reduce manual cycle counts in sub-zero environments.

item.title: Häagen-Dazs Debuts 6 Treats Designed to Help You Slow Down and Savor
item.description: This new product lineup was designed with indulgence in mind, featuring decadent and balanced flavor combinations that Häagen-Dazs is known for, all with the goal to encourage ice cream lovers to savor every delicious bite.

item.title: Vertical Cold Storage's Indy Site Earns Organic Certification
item.description: By securing organic certification, the Indianapolis facility enables customers to consolidate SKUs from multiple origins into a single location.

item.title: Evolution Fresh Debuts New Logo, Consumer Campaign
item.description: Over the last two years, household penetration of Evolution Fresh has doubled, achieving a +31.1% growth in dollar sales across all channels, according to the latest Circana sales data.

item.title: Kraft Heinz Pauses Separation Plans, Plans $600M Investment in R&D, More
item.description: Millions planned for R&D, marketing and sales to "accelerate our return to profitable growth.”

item.title: CAULIPOWER Debuts Single-Serve Pizzas, Bowls
item.description: The launch includes single-serve pizzas, now available at Hy-Vee, and single-serve bowls, now available at Sprouts Farmers Market, with broader distribution rolling out nationwide.
